description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design, build and refine AI-powered software while working closely with customers to turn their workflow challenges into shipped features. The position combines engineering and product thinking, with a high degree of ownership in a fast-moving startup setting.
 What you'll do
 - Build and improve AI-driven software, taking responsibility for quality, scalability and performance from start to finish.
 - Work with sales and engineering colleagues to understand customer needs and turn them into released product.
 - Own testing, debugging and optimization so users have a smooth experience.
 - Help new customers get set up by resolving technical issues during rollout and system connections.
 - Keep technical documentation of designs, processes and systems current as the product evolves.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Roughly 2 to 4 years of professional software development, ideally on subscription software or products that use AI.
 - Solid hands-on production skills in Python or JavaScript.
 - Working knowledge of machine learning tooling and of at least one large cloud provider.
 - Comfort with ambiguity, initiative, and delivering practical solutions at a fast startup pace.
 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach when working across teams.
 Bonus points
 - Prior experience at a software company that handles large volumes of documents.
 - Hands-on work creating or improving automated data extraction workflows powered by machine learning.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, California, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
